name: Parser Expert
desc: Parse documents and extract data from PDFs, DOCX files, images, and webpages using Parser Expert's powerful API.

actions.name: upload_document
actions.description: Upload a document or provide a webpage URL to parse. Supported formats: PDF, DOCX, Image, Txt File (maximum 10 pages per document).

actions.name: get_extracted_data
actions.description: Retrieve the extracted data using the parser ID and bucket ID. The parser ID is returned when you upload a document.

guides.title: Parser Expert automation
guides.excerpt: Read our quick guide on Parser Expert automation. Discover how it works, explore common use cases, and learn how Activepieces can help.

guides.title: How to Extract Text From PDF in 3 Quick Steps
guides.excerpt: Learn how to extract text from PDF in three easy steps. Discover how Activepieces can help you extract text and automate the entire process.
